title: F0 tracking on real speech (small sample) and synthetic ground truth
hypothesis: The YIN/CMND estimator with the EXP-0011 octave rule tracks synthetic vowels within 2% of ground truth from 80 to 400 Hz, and on a small real subset (20 AISHELL-3 utterances, 44.1 kHz) shows no systematic octave error: median F0 per utterance is coherent with speaker gender and re-estimating at 24 kHz changes the median by less than 3%.

git.status: dirty: uncommitted P1.3 work (corpus/mandarin/dataset modules, tests, experiments)

notes: Hypotheses 1-2 failed: default estimator octave-errors at 210/300 Hz (98% frames, ~2 octaves), glides still 12% after fmax_hz=500. v1 report kept as evidence of the f0=0 counting bug. 12 distinct test speakers, median F0 120.9-289.9 Hz.
